# DewertOkin CLASSIC handset (6 keys): manufacturer STEP

Not in git. DewertOkin publishes it as a free download but states no licence that allows
redistribution, so download it yourself and put it here as `CLASSIC_6_keys.STEP`:

- STEP: https://www.dewertokin.com/fileadmin/template/website/zertifikate/handschalter/CLASSIC_6_keys.STEP
- Index of handset CAD files: https://www.dewertokin.com/contact/downloads/3d-cad-data/handsets/

Downloaded 2026-11-02. SHA-256 of the file used:
`adeac2810e1b96866824e4200ab668e7be0daad5161b208bf931661c1891f696`

Used only to measure the remote and to check its fit in the cup (`cad/fit_remote.py`). No part here is
made from it; the slim shell's button pitch and row spacing were read off it.
